2105-4359-5144-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4359-5144-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4359-5144-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

728-1339-2835.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-1339-2835.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

654-5531-5694-7874-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-5531-5694-7874-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, The Immortal Weapons and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, The Immortal Weapons and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the The Immortal Weapons trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-5531-5694-7874-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink The Immortal Weapons and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

4247-6982--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When that creature enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a +1/+1 counter on it and not copying a Human

628-2034-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a non-Human creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-2034-7936.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a non-Human you control with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then also enter with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5147-6249-7920--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5147-6249-7920--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Tresserhorn's Lord trigger.
Resolve the Tresserhorn's Lord trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5434-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5434-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5434-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1912-2713-7426-7648.description:
Activate Assassin Den by paying {U} due to Zirda and Biomancer's Familiar, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat.

193-1556-3604.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Scorched Ruins.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-1556-3604.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

117-1618-2440-2806.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Talrand
117-1618-2440-2806.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Talrand triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Reality Strobe.
Repeat.
117-1618-2440-2806.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Talrand. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

1824-2530-2906-7360.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-2906-7360.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
1824-2530-2906-7360.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
God-Pharaoh's Faithful triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

240-413-4460-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

2921-3621-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2921-3621-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

2653-2893-5455-6763.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1456-4195-4211-4574.description:
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

985-4659-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
985-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

483-821-2173-5220.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

339-413-677-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
339-413-677-4068.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4885-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2038-4499-4772.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kozilek's Predator.
When Kozilek's Predator enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter and without summoning sickness

2335-2760-3143-4613.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2335-2760-3143-4613.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Xavier Sal using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

2034-2556-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
2034-2556-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Mnemonic Wall and at least two other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing three of the creatures returned in step 1, adding six {C}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

5686-6431--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1339-6092-6235.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-6092-6235.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Agate Instigator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
The Locust God triggers for each card drawn this way.
Resolve a trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat from step 3.

3480-4053-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
3480-4053-5499--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

877-1374-5645-5910.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to Stenn and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

2733-3129-4050-5043.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Faerie tokens, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2644-4336-4763-5147.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching Sai of the Shinobi to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

147-554-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-554-2034.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

141-1567.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Momentary Blink.
141-1567.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Momentary Blink, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Momentary Blink, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.

570-2024-3842.notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
570-2024-3842.description:
Cast Planewide Celebration by paying {5}{G}{G}, creating at least one 2/2 Citizen creature token that's all colors.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{W}{G}, giving Faeburrow Elder +3/+3 until end of turn and untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
